Joe (sales): Heads up — Vanguard reported p95 jump from ~120ms to ~420ms on the hosted API since yesterday's routing change. They're calling this a potential SLA issue, asking for triage and ETA.
Maria L: Thanks Joe. Adding to intake. @Ajay @Sophie can you confirm affected model, region, and whether this is Dedicated or Hosted? Any immediate workaround?
Ajay S: They're on hosted, model=redwood-70b-quant, region=eu-west-1. Quick glance: a subset of requests are falling back to variant redwood-70b-quant-cpu after the routing service marked some GPU workers as unavailable. Fallback rate ~12% over last 30m.
Ajay S: Logs snippet:
```
2026-04-23T14:02:11Z routing: shard=eu-west-1 node=gpux-12 health=degraded
2026-04-23T14:02:12Z routing: decision=fallback variant=redwood-70b-quant-cpu req_id=0x7f
2026-04-23T14:02:12Z latency: p95=420ms p50=130ms
```
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: routing-service v2.14.1 -> prod at 1997501300
Sophie C: We merged a packing preference tweak yesterday to prefer binpack in eu-west-1 to reduce cost. That reduced warm worker headroom; pack density spike may be causing the worker drains Ajay's seeing. Reverting packing preference will increase cost but reduce fallbacks.
Joe (sales): Vanguard says they're on an enterprise contract expecting business-critical performance. If this hits production SLA they may escalate. They want it fixed within 48h.
Maria L: We need a decision: hotfix (revert pack policy) vs mitigation (increase capacity/autoscale) vs per-customer routing pin. Which is fastest/lowest-risk?
Ajay S: Hotfix is config-only and low-risk. I can prepare a config revert for routing-service; rollout ~15m once approved, rollback immediate. Mitigation: bumping min nodes or reserved pool also works; reserved pool for Vanguard would take ~2h to provision.
Sophie C: I can bump autoscale-min in eu-west-1 by +3 immediately — low blast radius and should reduce fallbacks quickly. I'll also stage the revert so we can flip it after autoscale stabilizes. Note: cost impact while autoscale is higher.
Oliver K: FYI the CPU fallback variant has ~4x p95 vs GPU for long sequences. If Vanguard uses long seq lengths their users will feel it more. Postmortem item: consider per-customer routing pins to quant-tuned variants.
Maria L: Decision: Sophie to bump min nodes now; Ajay to stage the config revert as a hotfix ready to roll once autoscale is stable. Joe please tell Vanguard: temporary mitigation ETA 3h (visible improvement ~30m), full revert/monitoring within 24h. Also we need a product-backlog ticket.
Ajay S: Opening ticket PROD-4532 routing-fallback-vanguard (adds logs, diagnostics, rollback plan). Marking P0 per Maria. I'll run smoke tests after revert and post results here.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 routing-fallback - Vanguard. PagerDuty notifications sent.
Joe (sales): Thanks all — I'll update Vanguard now with the plan and ETA. Will escalate on their side if anything changes. :thumbsup:
